info.title: ZArchiveSharp CLI
info.description: Command-line tool for creating and extracting ZArchive files using ZArchiveSharp

options.name: --frame-size
options.description:
New frame every S bytes: 10, 10B, 10K, 10M, 10G
(default: 2M; capped at 1G)

options.name: --no-checksum
options.description: No frame checksums (also --no-check; last flag wins)

options.name: --seek-table-file
options.description:
Write a standalone Head table there instead of
appending the Foot table (decompress: read the
table from there instead of the file tail)

options.name: --to
options.description: End at decompressed byte S (default: end)

options.name: --from-frame
options.description:
Start at frame N (not with --from)
First frame shown (default: 0)
Last frame shown, inclusive (default: last)

options.name: --to-frame
options.description: End after frame N inclusive (not with --to)

options.name: --seek-table-format
options.description:
foot reads the appended table (default); head
means the input IS a standalone table file
Common options (compress/decompress; list takes -q/-h only):

options.name: --dict
options.description:
Dictionary file (zstd -D semantics: never stored,
keep it alongside; required on both sides for dict frames)

options.name: --stdout
options.description:
Explicit stdout (already the default when no output
path is given; an error together with one)

options.name: --no-check
options.description: Do not write a checksum (default; last flag wins)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
Note: inside 'zar zstd', -c means --compress (not --stdout).

options.name: --dict
options.description:
Dictionary file (pack/zstd; kept alongside,
never stored; --no-compress ignores it)

options.name: --stdout
options.description:
Stream to stdout (only with 'zar zstd'; inside
'zar zstd', -c means --compress instead)

options.name: --no-check
options.description: Do not write checksums (default; last wins)

options.name: --policy
options.description:
Collision policy: fail, skip, overwrite, auto-rename
(only with --batch; single paths always refuse)

options.name: --batch
options.description: Batch process all files in input directory

options.name: --mode
options.description:
Batch stages (default: auto; only with --batch):
auto: archives-(7z)-ISO/dir-.zar, ISOs-.zar, dirs-.zar
extract-archive: extract archives with 7z, stop there
extract-iso: convert ISOs to .zar;
compress: pack directories to .zar

options.name: --seven-zip
options.description: the standard install location; only with --batch)

options.name: --keep-originals
options.description:
Keep batch sources after packing (default; last wins
against --delete-source; only with --batch)

options.name: --delete-source
options.description:
Delete each batch source dir after its pack succeeds
(only with --batch)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help
named 'zstd' must be spelled ./zstd to pack/extract it.
./seekable escape for a colliding path).
